messages:
nora_sre: Postmortem follow-up: capturing the action items we agreed on for GPU autoscale and capacity. I'm owning the tracker but please confirm owners/dates here so INF board matches.

ashley_platform: I'll take the scheduler experiments (burst-smoothing policy + KV-cache pre-warm token). Plan: implement a 2s admission delay for large batch pods, add pre-warm trigger that seeds KV cache for 1 GPU in each zone. Testing on staging this afternoon.

devon_scheduler: I'll file a quota escrow request for the dedicated pool (us-west-2) — propose +5 GPUs staged as +2 immediate, +3 after 14 days if headroom still low. Draft PR by Tuesday.

maria_capacity: I'll run a focused headroom sim including partner sync bursts and the recent nightly ETL window. I'll include metrics for tail probability and time-to-warm. Report by Monday EOD.

ben_oncall: Ops will publish an "emergency GPU scale" one-pager with the manual commands, the warmup job shortcut, and the rollback knobs (eviction penalty, traffic-router TTL). ETA: tomorrow.

lina_partnership: I'll own partner outreach if we recommend shifting sync windows; will draft communication templates.

infra-bot: Created INF-5222: "Burst-smoothing + pre-warm experiment" (owner: ashley_platform) | due 2024-07-15

nora_sre: Agreed owners/due dates: scheduler experiments @ashley_platform due 2024-07-15, quota escrow PR @devon_scheduler due 2024-07-16, headroom sim @maria_capacity due 2024-07-14, ops playbook @ben_oncall due 2024-07-12, partner comms @lina_partnership due 2024-07-18.

ashley_platform: Experiment sketch: add a burst-smoothing admission controller that enforces a 2s stagger for bulk pod admits and fires a /ops/warmup token which preloads KV cache. Config snippet: 
```
admission:
  burstSmoothingDelayMs: 2000
  preWarmKV: true
```
Will post staging runs and logs here.

devon_scheduler: PR will include a "quota escrow" clause — we request temporary headroom while infra verifies scheduler gains, with automated rollback if spend delta exceeds threshold. Adding cost estimate in the PR and tagging finance.

maria_capacity: Early sim notes: smoothing reduces 99th tail by ~18% for the largest bursts; pre-warm avoids ~30s of cold-KV latency per new pod. CSV uploaded: https://internal/reports/headroom-226543.csv

ben_oncall: Playbook added to ops-playbooks. Manual emergency steps sample:
```
# emergency add
/ops/warmup start --pool=dedi-us-west --units=2 --token=kv-prewarm
kubectl annotate deploy inference warmup=true -n redwood
# check routing TTL and eviction penalty before returning to normal
```
Also added a Slack shortcut to trigger the warmup workflow.

lina_partnership: Draft partner note ready; will propose moving non-critical syncs out of the 02:30-04:00 UTC window if Maria's sim shows benefit.

nora_sre: Two follow-ups: 1) Maria — include a comparison of schedule-shift vs pre-warm cost over 30 days; 2) Devon — include alerting rules in PR so we auto-notify when headroom <22%.

ashley_platform: Will add canary plan: 8% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 48h, health gates: 99th latency change <5%, errors <0.5%. Will post canary job link.

devon_scheduler: Will add alert thresholds and the escrow expiry to the PR. Tagging finance reviewers.

maria_capacity: Will include the 30-day cost comparison and the sensitivity to partner-shifts.

infra-bot: Created INF-5223: "Quota escrow PR review" (owner: devon_scheduler) | due 2024-07-16

nora_sre: Thanks everyone. Keep links to PRs, canary logs, and the headroom CSV in this thread. We'll regroup in 7 days to close outstanding items.
